base: Experiment 009 mixed numeric-language model; 16D shared ganglion; matched three seeds; 800 mixed steps
precision_activation: numeric local expert only when numeric evidence is present; language local expert only when text evidence is present
blend: shared + alpha*(local-shared); probabilities use convex probability mixture
alpha_cap_reason: retain a nonzero shared-path contribution in precision outputs
alpha_selection: 20% internal validation split for long precision; same alpha used whenever that native modality is present
numeric_target: proper quantile distribution of an independent remeasurement; q10/q25/q50/q75/q90
language_target: six semantic 3-class variables; stochastic paraphrase observation; no exact sentence reproduction
cross_modal_rule: when native evidence is absent the precision branch is inactive, so cross-modal predictions remain exactly on the shared path
ganglion_retention_test: remove top two learned Experiment 009 delta-M SVD directions; compare with norm-matched random perturbation
